idea: Cold, quiet menace, mid fifties: a smooth, well-spoken Home Counties RP voice that never raises its volume, spitting each word through his teeth. Realistic and chilling rather than comic, the class difference carried by control and contempt; gives the editor a subtler option under the car glass.
tone: A man in his mid fifties with a smooth, refined, upper-class southern English accent, Received Pronunciation, expensively educated and used to being obeyed. A senior British minister on the phone in the back of his car, icy and contemptuous, barely holding his temper. He speaks low and slow through gritted teeth, biting each word off precisely, with the last word snapped hard. Close microphone, dry, voice only, grounded like a serious BBC political drama.
